title: Google\Cloud\Compute\V1\InterconnectDiagnostics
name: InterconnectDiagnostics
description: Diagnostics information about interconnect, contains detailed and current technical information about Google's side of the connection.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.arp_caches
params.description: A list of InterconnectDiagnostics.ARPEntry objects, describing individual neighbors currently seen by the Google router in the ARP cache for the Interconnect. This will be empty when the Interconnect is not bundled.

params.name: data.links
params.description: A list of InterconnectDiagnostics.LinkStatus objects, describing the status for each link on the Interconnect.

params.name: data.mac_address
params.description: The MAC address of the Interconnect's bundle interface.
